rows.ARS:
Light pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORnokiva
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2000).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2000.
rows.Bloom: Light pink. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Ludwigs Roses says this rose is name din celebration of the 140th birthday of the Girls High School in Stellenbosch in the year 2000...
